name: Camping 101: Cooking
summary: As you learn to cook, a basic campfire gives you a hearth for camping beyond fortified walls. Across Alliance and Horde lands, cooking trainers show new adventurers how to kindle one and prepare for life in the wild.

sections.title: The Hearth of the Wilderness
sections.body: Beyond fortified walls, a campfire boils water and roasts meat. Its flames give you a hearth when you travel through unfamiliar country and make camp.

sections.title: From Embers to Encampments
sections.body: Apprentice cooks kindle small fires with few surroundings. As your cooking grows, you can light larger fires for more elaborate campsites. Other practical trades teach you to make useful furnishings.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: New adventurers visit a cooking trainer in a nearby settlement to learn basic cooking and light a basic campfire for an outdoor campsite.

faq.q: Who offers this quest to travelers?
faq.answer: Experienced wilderness guides and adventurers offer this training across both factions. They include Eleanor Shackleton, Eric Brighthammer, Lyreena Duskblade, Sam Sarsaparilla, Brakk, Kaga Wildhoof, and Raan Wildwind.

faq.q: Where do Alliance players turn this in?
faq.answer: Alliance adventurers report to trainers in their home territories, such as Tomas in Goldshire, Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos, or Zarrin in Dolanaar.

faq.q: Where do Horde players turn this in?
faq.answer: Horde adventurers can learn with Cook Torka in Razor Hill, William Pickman in Brill, or Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Can campsite size be expanded later?
faq.answer: Yes. Greater cooking skill teaches you to kindle larger fires that support more camp furnishings in the wild.

faq.q: Can other professions contribute to camping?
faq.answer: Yes. Cooking provides the basic campfire, while other trades teach you to craft practical furnishings if you have practiced them.

angles.text: Cooking provides food to restore your strength and a basic campfire for the heart of an outdoor camp.
As an Alliance adventurer leaving Northshire, Dun Morogh, or Teldrassil, you are guided toward towns like Goldshire, Kharanos, and Dolanaar. There you learn self-reliance before braving the wilds.
As a young Horde fighter in Durotar, Mulgore, or Tirisfal, you are directed toward campfires in Razor Hill, Bloodhoof Village, or Brill.
